prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset: ONE square launcher icon for a Plants vs Zombies game on a BBK H1 handheld. Image 1 is a style reference ONLY: match its early-2010s native launcher icons: glossy rounded-square colored plate, thick beveled silver-white edge, softly raised toy-like 3D illustration and strong readability at 48x48 pixels. Image 2 is subject context only; replace the old English logo entirely. Create a single polished launcher icon, front-on view: cheerful vivid green peashooter head and its two leaves in foreground, small humorous gray-green zombie head peeking behind, sunny yellow-green rounded square backplate, convincing embossed rim and restrained glassy highlight at top. Very simple large silhouettes, two subjects only, no little decorative elements. The icon fills the square with a small transparent margin outside the rounded corners. No text, letters, words, ribbon, watermark or black rectangular background. Genuine transparent outer background. Deliver one centered square icon, not a screenshot or mockup.
